high_level_description: The image depicts a bustling street market scene in front of a building with a sign that reads "East Street Eye Clinic." The clinic is part of the NHS (National Health Service), as indicated by the text on the sign. The building has a brick facade with multiple windows, some of which have curtains. In the foreground, there are several people engaged in shopping at the market. They are examining and selecting fresh produce from stalls covered with striped canopies. The produce includes items such as potatoes, red bell peppers, and cucumbers, all displayed in cardboard boxes.
